sources.entry: AI Switcher - Switch Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and Antigravity CLI accounts with named profiles, one-click contexts and per-repository rules.

summary.one_liner: A local-first Tauri 2 desktop app (React + TypeScript UI, Rust bridge) that switches between saved coding-agent account profiles by driving the separate `aisw` runtime.
summary.what_it_does: The app manages saved profiles for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and Antigravity CLI. From a native desktop UI you can switch one tool or a saved multi-tool set at once. It runs diagnostics, verification, repair, and backup flows through the `aisw` runtime. It supports bundled, system, and custom `aisw` runtime sources. Credentials and provider-specific auth handling are kept inside the runtime layer, not the desktop app. The README describes the app as a control plane for `aisw`, not a replacement for its switching logic.
use_cases: switch between multiple Claude Code accounts
manage Codex CLI logins and profiles
switch Gemini CLI accounts from a desktop app
back up and verify coding-agent account state
switch a set of coding tools together
how_to_run: npm run tauri:bundle-local (unsigned local smoke bundle)
notable: Depends on a separate `aisw` runtime binary that acts as the source of truth for switching, backups, and auth
Can use a bundled, system, or custom `aisw` runtime
Includes a bridge contract test against a real `aisw` binary run in a throwaway HOME
Release verifier checks CI, workflow, capability, and packaging contracts
caveats: Explicitly in active alpha; rough edges and runtime integration issues are expected
Requires a staged `aisw` binary before building, which is not tracked in the repo
Requires Node.js >=20.19.0, npm >=10, and a Rust toolchain
